criteria.prompt: The frame shows the game rendering normally. FAIL if the image is fully (or almost fully) black, i.e. a blank/black screen with no visible game UI.
All UI text labels are cleanly separated and legible. FAIL if any two text labels overlap each other (glyphs drawn on top of each other) so neither is cleanly readable.
In battle/reward scenes, at least one card shows illustrated art (a non-flat textured region inside a card frame), not a blank or solid-color box.
In battle scenes, the player and enemy HP values (numbers or HP bars with numeric labels) are visible and legible.
In battle scenes, the number of visible hand cards in the frame matches the hand count given in the state digest.
In battle scenes, each living enemy shows a visible intent icon or intent text (its planned move) above or beside it.
